row.proto: void Sess_Rules_InvalidateLap_Thunk(void *rules, uint8_t car, uint8_t kind)
row.notes: 5-byte jmp into .data1 body=0x1505c44c0 (plaintext in the KB file). The rules update 0x14356bb00 calls it at 0x14356bb64 for each queued event of [rules+0x1bf8] (event +0x10 car, +0x28 kind). Kind 0 returns. It finds the lap validity component (type node 0x146076480) in [[rules+0x1c38]+0x88]'s component list +0x238..+0x240. Kind 2 takes lap offset +1 and kind 3 offset -1; for car 0 with the component's +0x28b set they clear +0x288 (kind 2) or +0x289 (kind 3), and they make the lap record at index u8 +0x9c80 plus the offset invalid (0x1505c46b0) and report it. With +0x28b set, for car 0 it clears +0x28a, then sets bit 0 (not clean) of telemetry lap slot 0's summary flags +0x2c0 (0x1505c4720) when +0x28a or +0x288 is 0 and of slot 1's (0x1505c4752) when +0x289 is 0, and stores 1 in +0x289 and +0x28a. Every kind then makes the current lap's record invalid (0x1505c47b6) and tail-jumps Sess_LapTimes_ReportLapInvalidation_Thunk 0x142f2bda0 (lapTimes, car, lap, 0). Lap record: [[rules+0x1c48]+0x58][car] + index*200, index at most 199, valid while (u64 +0xe0 & 1) == u8 +0xd8; an invalid write stores +0xd8 = ((+0xe0 & 1) == 0). The KB body computes 200 and the component offset 0x18 from obfuscated constants (0x4c0000c8 - [0x1487314e6] = 0xc8, 0x508b49ca ^ [0x1528ec4b8] = 0x18). Steam 1.0.145 thunk 0x143577260 (body 0x15002f460) and EA 1.0.145 0x143567460 (body 0x14efc1eb0, restored dump): aligned 196 and 198 of 203 instructions, the differences only those constants (Steam: plain 0x18 and imul 0xc8; EA: 0xd9894ea1 - [0x153aa9d4c] = 0xc8) and nop encodings, every field use at the same place.
